title: vitex wilmsii var. reflexa
intro: Vitex wilmsii var. reflexa, commonly known as Chasteberry, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to South Africa. The plant has been traditionally used to support women's health, particularly in regulating menstrual cycles, alleviating symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS), and relieving symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and mood swings. The health benefits of Chasteberry are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-stress effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have a positive impact on hormonal balance and overall well-being.
